rows.name: carrying commits both hands and the original heading under active inputs
setdown rejects a blocked broad footprint and preserves the lifted shield
current masonry obstructing the held shield retires its dependent work
losing the carry skill removes the carried wall before further movement
disconnect immediately retires the carried wall while the ally remains
fatal owner damage immediately retires the carried wall in an active party
changing weapon while carried retires its dependent wall
host exit clears the wall and carry controller
setting and picking up again retains damage, identity and first expiry

scope: Controlled copied Game lifecycle checks at an actual 3-SP research purchase. Selected damage and masonry are injected to isolate state boundaries. No canonical or online claim.
